title: Approved program charter with adoption record
description: Signed or otherwise attributable adoption record of the security program charter by the governing body, with version, scope and next review date.
format: PDF or Markdown with signed adoption record
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Annual program report to governing body
description: Written report on program status, material risks, exceptions, incidents and recommendations, with acknowledgment by the governing body.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Qualified individual appointment record
description: Appointment of the CISO or qualified individual with qualifications summary, reporting line, deputy, and, if contracted, the oversight arrangement.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Policy register export
description: Machine-readable list of policies and rule identifiers with owner, version, approval date, review due date and mapped enforcement mechanism.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Gate decision log for mandatory rules
description: Per-change record of each mandatory rule evaluated at merge and release, outcome, and any exception relied on.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Exception register snapshot
description: Current exceptions with scope, approver, compensating controls and expiry; count and age summary.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Monthly control effectiveness summary
description: Generated metrics with population counts, query hashes and run logs; labeled first-party.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)
notes: Folio is a candidate renderer; its suitability is not verified.

title: Training completion and enforcement records
description: Per-person completion of onboarding, annual and role-based training, and access suspensions for overdue training.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Agent execution provenance
description: Execution identity (actor kind, declared provider, model, runtime) linked to each change, with gate results and human approvals.
producer: Praxis (existing in development repositories; self-declared identity)
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)
notes: Exists in Echelon development repositories; not bound to authenticated identity and not operated for a production service.

title: Independent assurance report or assessment letter
description: SOC 2 Type 2 report, SOC 1 Type 2 report where relied on, or independent program assessment letter.
producer: not yet assigned (external auditor or assessor)
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)
